en: The postcard features a collage with a uniformed soldier, likely an Alpine trooper (Alpino) from Italy, standing on a snowy mountain with other soldiers in the background. He holds an Italian flag with an older Savoyard coat of arms. There's a large greeting, 'Saluti da Trento,' and two inset images: one shows the Trento-Sardagna cableway station perched on a cliff with the city and mountains in the background, and the other shows a building labeled 'Trento - Caserma Cesare Battisti.' There are also decorative flowers on the edge.
